# AI Solutions Wiki

> Engineering reference for production AI systems. Architecture patterns, evaluation methods, operational practices, governance frameworks, and tooling for teams building enterprise-grade AI. Maintained by AWS Community Hero Linda Mohamed.

This site is an open, vendor-neutral knowledge base aimed at engineers, architects, and decision-makers shipping AI in production. Content is organised around the layers of a real AI stack — data, models, retrieval, orchestration, evaluation, deployment, observability, and governance — with cross-links between concepts, patterns, tools, and reference architectures.

Editorial standard: each entry follows a consistent structure (definition, mechanism, when to use, trade-offs, references) and links to primary sources where applicable (vendor documentation, ISO / NIST / EU standards, peer-reviewed literature). Source repository: https://github.com/linda-mhmd/ai-solutions-wiki. Citation metadata: CITATION.cff in the source repository (CFF 1.2.0, CC-BY-4.0).

## Maintainer

- [Linda Mohamed](https://lindamohamed.com): AWS Community Hero, AI Architect, founder of the AI workshop programme at https://ai-workshops.online
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/linda-mohamed/

## Foundations

- [Software Foundations for AI Systems](https://ai-solutions.wiki/foundations/): software engineering, data engineering, and ML fundamentals underlying production AI
- [Glossary](https://ai-solutions.wiki/glossary/): definitional reference for AI, ML, MLOps, data, software architecture, and governance terms
- [Layers](https://ai-solutions.wiki/layers/): the layered model of an AI system — from infrastructure to interface

## Architecture

- [Architecture](https://ai-solutions.wiki/architecture/): reference architectures and design analysis for AI systems
- [Patterns](https://ai-solutions.wiki/patterns/): reusable technical patterns (RAG, agents, pipelines, orchestration)
- [Case Patterns](https://ai-solutions.wiki/case-patterns/): production implementation patterns drawn from real use cases

## Build and Operate

- [Build](https://ai-solutions.wiki/build/): hands-on guides for building AI features and shipping production systems
- [Guides](https://ai-solutions.wiki/guides/): step-by-step tutorials covering MLOps, testing, evaluation, deployment
- [Tools](https://ai-solutions.wiki/tools/): vendor-neutral analysis of AWS, Azure, GCP, and open-source AI services
- [Comparisons](https://ai-solutions.wiki/comparisons/): side-by-side comparisons (CrewAI vs LangGraph, RAG vs Fine-Tuning, Bedrock vs Azure OpenAI, Pinecone vs OpenSearch, etc.)

## Solutions and Domains

- [Solutions](https://ai-solutions.wiki/solutions/): industry-specific AI applications (media, financial services, insurance, geospatial)

## Frameworks and Governance

- [Frameworks](https://ai-solutions.wiki/frameworks/): governance, regulatory, and methodological frameworks for AI teams (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, GDPR, NIS2, DORA)

## Discovery

- [Sitemap](https://ai-solutions.wiki/sitemap.xml): full URL index
- [RSS feed](https://ai-solutions.wiki/index.xml): latest articles
- [Search index (JSON)](https://ai-solutions.wiki/index.json): structured site index
